continued_arm: Separate horizon-conditioned model, trained only on registered training-source continuation labels.
limitation: The intervention changes available continuation observations and training evidence together; differences do not establish causal importance.
no_temporal_arm: Original immediate conditional evaluated against the same endpoint reference labels.

calibration.interpretation: Diagnostic comparison of raw A-channel strength with held-out directional labels. Channels are not normalized; confidence is shown only as an evidence/selection parameter. Unknown and no-demonstrated labels are excluded from this binary diagnostic.

continued.interpretation: Accuracy concerns answered, directionally labeled pairs; unknown teacher labels are excluded, and abstention-inclusive accuracy is separate. No-demonstrated preference is not a forced direction.

immediate_without_continuation.interpretation: Accuracy concerns answered, directionally labeled pairs; unknown teacher labels are excluded, and abstention-inclusive accuracy is separate. No-demonstrated preference is not a forced direction.

uncertainty.limitations: Small panels and selected tactical sources limit generalization; intervals do not capture teacher-label or source-selection uncertainty.
uncertainty.method: Percentile 95% cluster bootstrap over connected ancestry components; all correlated rows travel together.
